description: This is a 3D-rendered birthday cake featuring a light yellow base with white frosting that drips down the sides. It is decorated with whipped cream dollops, several reddish-brown spherical ornaments, and a chocolate plaque that reads "Happy Birthday."

This low-poly 3D birthday cake features a pale yellow base with white frosting dripping down the sides, topped with several pinkish-brown round ornaments and white cream swirls. A dark brown rectangular chocolate plaque sits in the center, which is blank in some views and displays the "Happy Birthday" text in others.

A dark chocolate rectangular plaque sits in the center, which displays the text "Happy Birthday" in some views and is blank in others.

A 3D rendered birthday cake with a yellow base, white dripping frosting, and several peach-colored fruit toppings arranged around the top. In some views, a dark chocolate plaque displays "Happy Birthday" in white script, while others show the same plaque blank.
